about.title: I'm Selva
about.description1: Urban shaman, overtone singer, and sound therapist. My name means "jungle," and like it, I seek to create spaces of deep connection with each person's inner nature.
about.description2: I work with Tibetan singing bowls, native flutes, shamanic drums, and overtone singing to facilitate experiences of healing and deep relaxation. My mission is to bring the healing power of sound to spaces where it can have the greatest impact: wellness centers, nursing homes, companies, and hotels throughout Barcelona and beyond.
